record_title: Critical-tolerance Gaussian fluctuations and half-step CG law on Haar power-law spectra
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Fixed-degree exact-arithmetic result for the Haar power-law source model under (4d+2)p<1; it does not cover the variance-critical boundary or heavier-tail regime, growing degree, finite precision, or preconditioning. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; related CG fluctuation theory exists for other random-matrix ensembles.
